text_block_list.text:
The Mecha Umamusume ST-2, invented by
Doctor of Engineering Sugar Lights. Its appearance was...
The day to reveal it has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone, may I have your attention, please.
It is finally time for their entrance.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a machine. But inside, it's a state-of-the-art robot
running with the heart of an Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Here comes ST-2!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, Princess of Wheels. You'll need another
gladiator to contest the arena.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Shall we celebrate together—the fulfillment of our ideal?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Gimlet.
However, I will run alone. I—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I want to show them a competition.
Yes, what I want to show them is—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I am ST-2.
Pleased to meet you.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Some of you here right now may carry handicaps
and have given up on your dreams.
However...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Today, I want everyone to know that such techniques
and restoration methods exist.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Well then—here goes!
Tohh!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhhhhh!!
Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"This is incredible! She's accelerating faster and faster.
What breathtaking speed...!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's just like a real Umamusume!
Robotics has finally come this far!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(This running form is not something built in
a day or two. Indeed...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: (An intense load. Kris S trained me to be able to endure it. And...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(The body handling doesn't feel off by even a millimeter.
The one who tuned it for me... was Shakur.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Mission Accomplished.
Duty has been――fulfilled."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Alright, the link is solid.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: (I can run my absolute best in every single sector of the course. All thanks to Hayahide's data.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The sum of consistent times.
That is the true ideal...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(And into the final stretch!
The spark of passion passes from Gimlet)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: (Taishin taught me what it means to never give up!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Alright, time to dash!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Sing, and dance yourselves into a frenzy.
Tonight's wine is—exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: And what I wanted to see was—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this scenery...
Today... I can finally take my time and enjoy it...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't that I wanted to enter races
like in the old days. That's right..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to run fast, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I stumbled from injury and couldn't
take a direct path here. But even so...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
There are alternative paths.
As long as we don't give up... we'll surely find one.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
ST-2 has just crossed the finish line!
That was truly a remarkably smooth run.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: "This technology will surely become a new cornerstone for Umamusume—no, for all life on this planet."

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: "Ah, I'm truly glad... that it was you who came to greet me."
(Bzz)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, my dream came true.
Truly... thank you so much...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Ah, you can probably tell from that, but...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I am weeping.
Beyond a shadow of a doubt...

"Seeing that brought tears to my eyes as well.
Dr. Wrights' tears were—"

It was a drop of life that quenched my heart,
which had been dry ever since the injury.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Professor, wonderful work.
Listen to this applause.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Now that you've shown such an incredible run,
the next goal is—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Participating in races, perhaps?
I believe that is not impossible either."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...No, as you know,
that is not where my dream lies.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run just a little faster.
I want to see just a little better scenery."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Because that was my only dream.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Then there's nothing more you wish to do with us either...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"It's not as if I don't have
anything I want to do, though."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I?
'I just want to see a slightly better view.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A nice view...?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there is a view that you all see, which I have yet to behold.
That is—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
It's the view you see
when standing right in the center of the concert stage.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I ask of you all—won't you please
stand upon the same stage as me?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"I want to feel it. With this ST-2 body—
the exhilaration of standing in the center!"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, we naturally can't let spectators in
for this. That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
You are my only audience, Trainer.
Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.
choice_data_list: Thank you. I'll take a look.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Understood, let's definitely do it.
The Winning Live...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, though it might not be a "winning" one.
We didn't actually race, after all.

True, she isn't racing.
However...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

"Dr. Wright undoubtedly won.
Yes—"
choice_data_list: Let's put on the winning live of a lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Of my life... That's right.
I—triumphed over injury!

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Let us express it on the stage...
The joy of overcoming our handicaps and reaching for tomorrow!
